verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a project-management tool, and a shared visual whiteboard is a fair capability for that category, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a whiteboard or canvas. The nearby items are different features: Doc collaborators seeing proposed changes, a Figma integration (a third-party tool) and visualizing Epics on a Roadmap. None of these is a shared whiteboard, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a designer, I can collaborate visually with my team on a shared whiteboard
